footer.automated: This is an automated message from {{company}}.
footer.noReply: This is a send-only address — please do not reply to this email.

notice.subject: New Notice: {{title}}
notice.heading: New Notice
notice.body: A new notice has been posted.

invoice.subject: Invoice {{number}} — {{restaurant}}
invoice.heading: New Invoice
invoice.body: A new invoice has been generated for your restaurant.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {{platform}}
welcome.heading: Welcome!
welcome.body: Your account has been created successfully.

passwordReset.subject: Password Reset Request
passwordReset.heading: Password Reset
passwordReset.body: You requested a password reset. Click the button below to set a new password.
passwordReset.expiry: This link will expire in {{hours}} hours.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this, please ignore this email.

emailVerification.subject: Verify Your Email Address
emailVerification.heading: Email Verification
emailVerification.body: Please verify your email address by clicking the button below.
emailVerification.expiry: This link will expire in {{hours}} hours.

contractExpiry.issuerIntro: The following contract is approaching its end date and requires your action.
contractExpiry.applicantIntro: Your contract with {{issuer}} will expire on {{date}}. Please contact us to discuss renewal or transition.
contractExpiry.contactBody: For any questions about your contract, please contact us directly.

sellerReceived.subject: Confirm order: {{poNumber}} · {{buyer}} · {{total}}
sellerReceived.heading: New Purchase Order Received
sellerReceived.body: {{buyer}} has submitted a new purchase order to your company.
sellerReceived.hint: Please review the order and confirm or reject it. After confirmation you can start delivery with tracking info.

approvalPending.subject: Approve purchase: {{poNumber}} · {{buyer}} · {{total}}
approvalPending.heading: Purchase Order Awaiting Your Approval
approvalPending.body: {{buyer}} submitted a purchase order that needs your approval.
approvalPending.textFallback: Purchase order {{poNumber}} needs your approval. Total: {{total}}.

approvalResult.bodyApproved: Your purchase order has been approved and sent to the seller.
approvalResult.bodyApprovedExternal: Your purchase order has been approved. This supplier doesn't use the app, so it has not been sent — send it via WhatsApp, PDF or email from the order details.
approvalResult.bodyRevoked: The owner revoked the approval of this purchase order. It is awaiting approval again.
approvalResult.bodyRevokedExternal: The owner revoked the approval of this purchase order. It is awaiting approval again. If you already sent it to the supplier by WhatsApp, PDF or email, please let them know.

buyerConfirm.subject: Order placed: {{poNumber}} · to {{seller}}
buyerConfirm.heading: Your Purchase Order Was Placed
buyerConfirm.body: Your purchase order has been sent to {{seller}}.
buyerConfirm.hint: You will be notified when the seller confirms the order.
buyerConfirm.headingExternal: Your Purchase Order Is Ready to Send
buyerConfirm.bodyExternal: Your purchase order to {{seller}} was created, but it has not been sent — this supplier doesn't use the app.
buyerConfirm.hintExternal: Open the order and send it via WhatsApp, PDF or email.
buyerConfirm.textFallbackExternal: Purchase order {{poNumber}} to {{seller}} is ready but not sent — this supplier doesn't use the app. Send it via WhatsApp, PDF or email. Total: {{total}}.

externalSend.subject: Purchase Order {{poNumber}} from {{buyer}}
externalSend.heading: New Purchase Order
externalSend.body: {{buyer}} has placed a purchase order with you.
externalSend.hint: Please reply to this email to confirm the order.

buyerReceived.subject: Record dispatch: {{poNumber}} · received by {{buyer}}
buyerReceived.heading: Buyer Confirmed Receipt
buyerReceived.body: {{buyer}} has confirmed receipt of purchase order {{poNumber}}.
buyerReceived.hintNeedsShip: Your stock is deducted when you start delivery. Please record the delivery so your inventory stays correct.
buyerReceived.hintShipped: No action needed — this order is already out for delivery.
buyerReceived.autoCompleted: Completed automatically (buyer did not confirm within 3 days)
buyerReceived.bodyAuto: Purchase order {{poNumber}} for {{buyer}} was completed automatically — the buyer did not confirm receipt within 3 days of delivery.

returnExternalSend.subject: Return Request {{poNumber}} from {{buyer}}
returnExternalSend.heading: Return Request
returnExternalSend.body: {{buyer}} is returning items from purchase order {{poNumber}}.
returnExternalSend.hint: Please reply to this email to confirm the return and the credit amount.

schedule.sentBody: Your standing order {{schedule}} placed this week's order with {{seller}}.
schedule.pendingHeading: Standing Order Waiting for Owner Approval
schedule.pendingBody: This week's order from {{schedule}} needs the Owner's approval before it goes out: {{reason}}
schedule.failedHeading: Standing Order Could Not Be Placed
schedule.failedBody: This week's order from {{schedule}} to {{seller}} was not created.
schedule.pausedBody: {{schedule}} to {{seller}} was paused after repeated failures. Fix the problem, then resume it.
schedule.approvalBody: {{buyer}} wants to order the items below from {{seller}} automatically ({{cadence}}). Once you approve, each order goes out without asking again — unless the total changes by more than {{tolerance}}%.
schedule.approvedBody: The Owner approved {{schedule}}. Orders will be placed automatically ({{cadence}}).
schedule.rejectedBody: The Owner rejected {{schedule}}. It is paused and no orders will be placed.
schedule.recordedHeading: This Week's Standing Order Was Recorded
schedule.recordedBody: Your standing order {{schedule}} recorded this week's order with {{seller}}. Nothing was sent to the supplier — they deliver and invoice under your subscription as usual. Mark it received when the goods arrive.

autoCompleted.subject: Completed automatically: {{poNumber}}
autoCompleted.heading: Order Completed Automatically
autoCompleted.body: Purchase order {{poNumber}} was completed automatically on {{date}} because receipt was not confirmed within 3 days of delivery. The stock has been added to your inventory.
autoCompleted.hint: If anything was missing or damaged, open the order and request a return.
autoCompleted.textFallback: {{poNumber}} was completed automatically on {{date}}. Stock has been added. If anything was missing or damaged, request a return from the order.

received.subject: Role request: {{role}} · {{target}}
received.heading: New Role Request
received.body: {{requester}} has requested a role. Please review it.

result.bodyApproved: Your role request was approved. It now appears as a card on your role selection screen.

leaveRequested.subject: Approve leave request: {{name}}
leaveRequested.heading: New leave request
leaveRequested.body: {{name}} has requested leave. Please approve or reject it.

leaveDecided.bodyApproved: Your leave request has been approved.
leaveDecided.bodyRejected: Your leave request was not approved.

received.subject: You're invited to join {{target}} as staff
received.heading: Staff invitation
received.body: {{inviter}} invited you to work at {{target}} as staff.
received.hint: Accept on the role selection screen. You keep signing in with your own account and switch to this store.
received.textFallback: {{inviter}} invited you to join {{target}} as staff.
received.subjectAdmin: You're invited to be the admin of {{target}}
received.bodyAdmin: {{inviter}} invited you to be the restaurant admin of {{target}}.
received.textFallbackAdmin: {{inviter}} invited you to be the restaurant admin of {{target}}.

result.bodyAccepted: {{who}} accepted your invitation and now appears in your staff list as a linked account.
